slices.focus: The oral-history portal launches publicly with stable record pages, neighborhood tags, and event calendar integration
slices.summary: Ariana completes the public launch of the oral-history portal with stable record pages, neighborhood tags, rights notes, and a listening-event calendar. She tests it with her mother Lorraine, who searches by family names and vanished corner stores, confirming the portal works as neighborhood memory.
open_loops: Adding a plain-language intro explaining rights notes at the top of the site
Running a small internal walkthrough focused on three search moves
Writing a stewardship list naming recurring maintenance tasks as core work
Conducting a few more one-on-one demos before designing group sessions
decisions: Ariana moved from targeted expansion work into stewarding a publicly launched neighborhood oral-history portal with sear
